title: Sequence ordering of letters (R Q P S)
subject: Polity
caption: Four possible orderings of letters R, Q, P, S with the correct sequence highlighted.
altText: A flow diagram showing a start node branching into four options labeled Option A through D. Each option leads to a chain of four letters representing a possible ordering of R, Q, P, S. Option B's chain (S → R → Q → P) is highlighted to indicate the correct sequence.
